species.name: Grayling
mustRead: tall sail-like spotted dorsal fin
small mouth on a trout-shaped body
adipose fin and forked tail

species.name: Minnow
mustRead: small slim silvery body
single soft dorsal fin set mid-back
dark lateral stripe

species.name: Sculpin
mustRead: oversized broad flattened head
huge fan-like pectoral fins propping it on the bottom
scaleless tapering tadpole-shaped body

species.name: Sturgeon
mustRead: rows of bony scutes ridging the back and flanks
four barbels under a long pointed snout
shark-like upturned asymmetric tail

species.name: Paddlefish
mustRead: long flat paddle-shaped rostrum a third of the body length
cavernous gaping toothless mouth
smooth scaleless skin and shark-like tail

species.name: Perch
mustRead: two separate dorsal fins, the front one spiny
dark vertical bars down green-gold flanks
orange-red pelvic and anal fins

species.name: Pacu
mustRead: deep coin-shaped compressed body
blunt steep forehead with an underslung jaw
flat square human-like teeth

species.name: Arapaima
mustRead: dorsal and anal fins set far back framing the tail like a paddle
large armoured scales edged in red at the rear
bony flattened head with a small upward mouth

species.name: Arowana
mustRead: steeply upturned drawbridge mouth
two barbels projecting from the chin
long ribbon dorsal and anal fins running to the tail

species.name: Electric Eel
mustRead: single long ribbon anal fin running the whole underside
no dorsal fin and no pelvic fins
blunt rounded flattened head
species.note: Not a true eel but a knifefish - it undulates the belly fin and has a flat-topped head, not an eel's continuous dorsal fringe.

species.name: Stingray
mustRead: flat kite-shaped disc of fused wing-like pectorals
long whip tail carrying a serrated barb
eyes on top with the mouth and gills underneath
species.note: Almost always drawn from above; in true side profile it is a thin wafer with a trailing whip.

species.name: Cichlid
mustRead: single long dorsal fin, spiny in front and soft behind
deep oval body with pointed trailing fin tips
thick-lipped sloping face

species.name: Tetra
mustRead: small deep-bodied silvery fish
tiny adipose fin behind the dorsal
bright lateral stripe from eye to tail

species.name: River Dolphin
mustRead: very long narrow tweezer beak crowded with teeth
low ridge or hump instead of a tall dorsal fin
bulging flexible melon and a mobile neck

species.name: Manatee
mustRead: rounded spatula paddle tail
blunt bristly downturned muzzle with a split upper lip
barrel body with front flippers and no hind limbs

species.name: Sunfish
mustRead: very deep round pancake-flat body
dark ear flap tab on the gill cover
tiny mouth on a small head
species.note: Ambiguous name - interpreted as a freshwater sunfish (bluegill type), not the oceanic mola.

species.name: Walleye
mustRead: large cloudy glassy reflective eye
two dorsal fins with a spiny front one
white tip on the lower lobe of the tail

species.name: Whitefish
mustRead: small blunt overhanging snout above a tiny mouth
adipose fin behind the dorsal
large silvery scales and a deeply forked tail

species.name: Lungfish
mustRead: eel-like body ending in a pointed continuous tail fin
thread-like filamentous limb fins
smooth scaled skin and a small blunt head

species.name: Tigerfish
mustRead: huge interlocking dagger fangs visible with the mouth closed
horizontal dark stripes along silver flanks
deeply forked red-tinged tail

species.name: Goldfish
mustRead: stubby deep orange body
flowing double fan tail
high arched back with a long dorsal fin

species.name: Mullet
mustRead: blunt flat-topped head with a tiny triangular mouth
two widely separated small dorsal fins
silvery torpedo body with faint stripes

species.name: Tarpon
mustRead: huge silver-dollar plate scales
upturned bulldog lower jaw
long trailing filament off the rear of the dorsal fin

species.name: Snapper
mustRead: sloping forehead running to a pointed snout
pair of canine teeth at the front of the jaw
continuous spiny dorsal fin over a stout body
